figs.name: zero-and-span-calibration-line-chart
figs.alt: zero and span calibration line y = 0.16x + 4 for a pressure transmitter
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog plotting the article equation y = 0.16x + 4: 0 PSI gives the 4 mA live zero, 50 PSI gives 12 mA and 100 PSI gives 20 mA.
figs.after_h2: Linear Slope Intercept Equation for Instrument Calibration
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Transmitter calibration line y equals 0.16x plus 4 with live zero</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">y = 0.16x + 4 for a 0 to 100 PSI, 4 to 20 mA Transmitter</text>
<line x1="110" y1="440" x2="510" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="440" x2="110" y2="80" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="440" x2="110" y2="446" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110" y="466" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
<line x1="210.0" y1="440" x2="210.0" y2="446" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="466" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">25</text>
<line x1="310.0" y1="440" x2="310.0" y2="446" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="310.0" y="466" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">50</text>
<line x1="410.0" y1="440" x2="410.0" y2="446" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="410.0" y="466" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">75</text>
<line x1="510" y1="440" x2="510" y2="446" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="510" y="466" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">100</text>
<line x1="104" y1="440" x2="110" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100" y="446" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">0</text>
<line x1="104" y1="368.0" x2="110" y2="368.0" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100" y="374.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">4</text>
<line x1="104" y1="224.0" x2="110" y2="224.0" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100" y="230.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">12</text>
<line x1="104" y1="80" x2="110" y2="80" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100" y="86" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">20</text>
<text x="310.0" y="494" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Input pressure, PSI</text>
<text x="60" y="70" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">mA</text>
<line x1="110" y1="368.0" x2="510" y2="368.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="224.0" x2="510" y2="224.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="80.0" x2="510" y2="80.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="368.0" x2="510" y2="80" stroke="#0891b2" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="310.0" y1="440" x2="310.0" y2="224.0" stroke="#164e63" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="224.0" x2="310.0" y2="224.0" stroke="#164e63" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<circle cx="310.0" cy="224.0" r="7" fill="#164e63"/><circle cx="110" cy="368.0" r="7" fill="#dc2626"/>
<text x="126" y="396.0" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Live zero:</text>
<text x="126" y="418.0" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">0 PSI gives 4 mA</text>
<rect x="545" y="90" width="235" height="300" rx="14" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0891b2" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="662" y="124" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">m = 16 ÷ 100</text>
<text x="662" y="158" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 0.16 mA per PSI</text>
<text x="662" y="192" font-size="18" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">b = 4 mA</text>
<text x="662" y="226" font-size="18" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">At 50 PSI:</text>
<text x="662" y="260" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.16 × 50 + 4</text>
<text x="662" y="294" font-size="18" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">= 12 mA</text>
<text x="662" y="328" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Span = 20 − 4</text>
<text x="662" y="362" font-size="18" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">= 16 mA</text>
<text x="400" y="540" font-size="18" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zero sets b, the intercept. Span sets m, the slope.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: zero-and-span-shift-diagram
figs.alt: zero and span adjustment diagram: zero shifts the line, span changes the slope
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing a zero adjustment, which moves the whole response line up or down, with a span adjustment, which changes the slope about the zero point.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Zero error shifts the line while span error changes its slope</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zero Shifts the Line, Span Tilts It</text>
<line x1="90" y1="400" x2="370" y2="400" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="90" y1="400" x2="90" y2="140" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="230.0" y="428" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Input 0 to 100 %</text>
<text x="80" y="146" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">Out</text>
<line x1="90" y1="348.0" x2="370" y2="140" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="90" y1="311.6" x2="330.79999999999995" y2="140.0" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>
<line x1="90" y1="384.4" x2="370" y2="176.4" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>
<line x1="230" y1="210.0" x2="230" y2="238.0" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="230" y1="284.0" x2="230" y2="254.0" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="220" y="80" font-size="20" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zero adjustment</text>
<text x="220" y="106" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">adds or subtracts, changes b</text>
<line x1="480" y1="400" x2="760" y2="400" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="480" y1="400" x2="480" y2="140" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="620.0" y="428" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Input 0 to 100 %</text>
<text x="470" y="146" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">Out</text>
<line x1="480" y1="348.0" x2="760" y2="140" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="480" y1="348.0" x2="760" y2="197.2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>
<line x1="480" y1="348.0" x2="698.4" y2="140" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>
<circle cx="480" cy="348.0" r="7" fill="#164e63"/>
<text x="494" y="376.0" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">pivot at zero</text>
<text x="610" y="80" font-size="20" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Span adjustment</text>
<text x="610" y="106" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">multiplies or divides, changes m</text>
<line x1="20" y1="470" x2="780" y2="470" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="60" y1="495" x2="100" y2="495" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="110" y="501" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Ideal line</text>
<line x1="300" y1="495" x2="340" y2="495" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>
<text x="350" y="501" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Instrument before adjustment</text>
</svg>

figs.name: zero-and-span-calibration-flowchart
figs.alt: zero and span calibration flowchart: set 4 mA at LRV, 20 mA at URV, repeat
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the back and forth calibration loop: set zero at 0 percent, span at 100 percent, then recheck zero because the two adjustments interact.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart of the zero and span calibration loop for an analog transmitter</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zero and Span Calibration Loop</text>
<rect x="250" y="56" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0891b2" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="90.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Apply 0 % input, the LRV</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="132" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="132" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#0891b2" stroke="#164e63" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="166.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Adjust zero for 4 mA</text>
<line x1="400" y1="188" x2="400" y2="208" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="208" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0891b2" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="242.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Apply 100 % input, the URV</text>
<line x1="400" y1="264" x2="400" y2="284" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="284" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#0891b2" stroke="#164e63" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="318.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Adjust span for 20 mA</text>
<line x1="400" y1="340" x2="400" y2="362" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,362.0 570.0,414 400,466.0 230.0,414" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#164e63" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="409.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zero still at 4 mA</text>
<text x="400" y="431.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">after span change?</text>
<line x1="570" y1="414" x2="610" y2="414" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="590" y="400" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="610" y="380" width="170" height="68" rx="10" fill="#16a34a" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="695.0" y="408.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Calibration</text>
<text x="695.0" y="432.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">complete</text>
<polyline points="230,414 150,414 150,84 248,84" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="140" y="400" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">No</text>
<text x="140" y="250" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">repeat</text>
<text x="400" y="510" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">In most analog instruments zero and span interact,</text>
<text x="400" y="536" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">so the technician goes back and forth until both are right</text>
</svg>
